first_score.scope: Held-out reviewer round, scored before repair; historical first score on the named snapshot. These cases are now known.
first_score.chronology_basis: Flame states these mutations were chosen after the repair and unseen by TV when first scored; no independent timestamp proof is supplied.
first_score.execution_basis: Flame executed the archived runner. TV parsed and bound the supplied records; TV did not rerun these mutations.
first_score.record_limits: The supplied output has suite summaries and at most three failing method names per case, not full stderr, fully qualified test names or per-case exit-code transcripts.
first_score.counting: Fourteen selected, related edits; not a general detection rate or a combined total with the 176 development cases.

curated.scope: Curated contract mutations; not exhaustive test coverage or proof of comment truth

contracts.claim: The shared replay runner applies the gate to a naturally stale reader proposal.
Edited current-head text cannot pass with a genuine event identity.
Selection obeys the UTF-8 byte budget even when characters and bytes differ.
The parent rejects undeclared evaluator fields before transport.
Same-process replies cannot be reported as fresh-process evidence.
Actual restore requests exclude evaluation labels.
Actual propose requests contain only the operation and selected context.
An exact older source is reported as stale, including when a later approval leaves the task active.
Serving independently rechecks evidence age
Unknown canary identifiers stop at closed-suite validation
Byte-identical candidate is not admitted
Private next state is validated before any temporary-file write
Stored lifecycle must match the recorded audit
Rollback revokes prior approval
Actual admission calls strict numeric validation before thresholds
Gallery success is derived from actual persisted rollback state
Admission reserves remaining lifecycle storage before accepting a near-full registry
The country filter limits the full emitted group list.
Joined multiplicity cannot weight the corrected trial cohort.
Bar labels name the method that produced the value.
Both bars begin at the zero origin.
Each edge begins at its own source trial.
Repeated identities are visibly marked.
Display preserves exact integer differences.
Median triangles are bound to actual recorded values.
A superset cannot satisfy the exact item-set criterion.
An authorized wait resets an already accumulated idle count.
Duplicate keys are rejected even when the last task identity is correct.
The development lexical baseline is inclusive at 0.88 and rejects 0.84.
Normal replay uses the evidence checker instead of accepting every result claim.
Recomputed agent-side hashes cannot replace the separately pinned digest.
An artifact cannot satisfy a different criterion merely because item sets match.

limitations.limit: Fixture-sensitive packing is not general memory quality.
Local role labels are not an authenticated release service.
Whole-trial totals do not measure patients enrolled in a country.
Healthy work can alert before its next verifiable milestone.
